lines.1: 「All right, Nagomin. Could you just organize the data for us today?」
lines.3: 「Hey, Black Hair. You're the only Nagomin here.」
lines.4: 「I find that name unpleasant. Just call me Yashi.」
lines.5: 「Sorry, it's already decided. I'm not changing it.」
lines.7: 「You really are quite the Princess. I'd heard the rumors.」
lines.8: 「I know. You can just call me Kiriya.」
lines.10: 「Hee hee. If you'd rather call me Big Sister, be my guest.」
lines.11: 「No. With all due respect and admiration, I'll call you Princess.」
lines.12: Was it just me, or was that dripping with sarcasm?
lines.13: 「Really? That works too, then. Though I'd rather be called Emperor or King than Princess.」
lines.15: Oh, that left her at a bit of a loss.
lines.16: That was the Princess for you. Even with rough company like Nagomi, she never lost her composure.
lines.17: 「Don't worry. I'm not going to call you 'Nagomin.'」
